title: Research: exclude three eleven-piece P112 beta profiles
body:
## Summary

Exclude the three eleven-piece P112 TWOSIDE `(b,t)=(5,6)` profiles `3,3,5^9`, `3,4,4,5^8` and `4^4,5^7` over every characteristic-zero field.

```text
four small pieces, support union <=32
seven residual quotient images, all nonzero
three in one class would give a 2D code kernel on <=68 coordinates
root rigidity forbids that kernel
odd seven-point remainder supplies a singleton and five-piece selection
six remaining pieces give an A5 simplex: 795 <=756, contradiction
```

Only `research/p112-eleven-piece-quotient/` is added. The new implication is quotient selection; the auxiliary kernel fact is weaker than the inherited generalized distance bound. Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 for TWOSIDE and C5, Nick Petalas/PR3169 and PR3171 for the retained geometry/simplex arguments, and the credited E8/P112 decoder lineage. Development and checks used substantial automated assistance.

## Evidence

- **Before:** All three profiles survive the original BK/BK7 filters. Across all 462 six-piece subsets per profile, the smallest support-cap sum is 56, so the earlier strict `<53` test certifies no quotient basis.
  **After:** The new quotient argument supplies the required five-piece selection with support cap 44. All three exclusions have incidence margin 39.
- Python 3.12 registered replay passes all 3,309,747 five-flats, 7,140 root-plane pairs, 960 reflections, all 77 original survivors and 17 optimized behavioral groups. A separate filter implementation and rational rank oracle corroborate the relevant steps.
- Python 3.13 optimized replay and all 17 tests pass from a read-only Git-free export. Warnings-as-errors compilation, applicable Ruff checks, metadata/pins and all 13 committed publication-byte comparisons pass.
- Internal mathematical and artifact reviews found no blocker. Hosted CI and independent human/proof-kernel review remain separate.

[Proof and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/e38c9cff85f2af817b403291285468ca3899f9c7/research/p112-eleven-piece-quotient), [exact local evidence](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e38c9cff85f2af817b403291285468ca3899f9c7/research/p112-eleven-piece-quotient/CHECKS.json), [canonical Discussion claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18999775).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Isolated.

This is a scoped obstruction, not full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission or a new kappa. The proof uses the standard Weyl-chamber theorem. Frozen inputs and selected frontier are unchanged. No full supplier, Lean or Docker replay is claimed.
